children: may retest resistance at $2.9325 per lb, as it has stabilised around a support at $2.8365 twice.
The stabilisation indicates both the completion of a wave (c) from $3.1735 and the formation of a small double-bottom. A break above $2.9325 could confirm this pattern and a target of $3.0245.
Immediate support is at $2.8755, a break below which could open the way toward $2.7835-$2.8365 range.
* The coffee report is published twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday.
